description: c34 compare pair, the ON copy: three requests on scratch projects (tests pass, tests fail, build). OFF: flags none, the engine runs the command with egdesk_run_command and then writes (the engine path). ON: EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=on, the Decision model picks the command, code runs it, ONE engine round with the result and no tool call. Run both with --decisions into two --out folders, then: node scripts/egdesk-real-engine-timing.mjs compare <off>/records <on>/records --normalize '-off|-on' (the conversation ids are the same in both copies; the set names differ by -off/-on).
